Exporting the store list

Run the export from the admin console. The --since flag limits it to stores changed after a date, and the output goes to standard output unless you pass a file.

contoso export stores --since 2026-11-01 > stores.csv
if [ -s stores.csv ]; then
    echo "done: $(wc -l < stores.csv) stores"
fi

A template uses three backticks itself:

```yaml
region: north
```
